definition: MeaningCloud is a Software as a Service product that enables users to embed text analytics and semantic processing in any application or system.
details: It was previously branded as Textalytics. MeaningCloud extends the concept of semantic API with a cloud-based framework that makes the integration of semantic processing into any system something close to a plug-and-play experience. MeaningCloud is available both in SaaS mode and on-premises.

explainer.lead: MeaningCloud is a cloud service for adding text analytics and semantic processing to applications. It matters because it offers semantic APIs as close to plug-and-play integration.

tiers.eli5: It is a ready-made service you call from your app to get meaning pulled out of text, instead of building the language machinery yourself.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers call it to extract topics, entities and sentiment rather than train their own models. A pitfall is that it can be run in SaaS mode or on-premises, so data-residency requirements shape which deployment you choose.
tiers.paperLevel: It is a software-as-a-service product built around semantic APIs; it extends the semantic API concept with a cloud-based framework. No formal definition or error bound is given.

explainer.example: A support tool sends incoming customer messages to the service and receives topics and sentiment for routing.
